query:
-- Verificar na inspection_charges
SELECT 'inspection_charges' as tabela, id, client_email, amount, due_date, payment_status,
  CASE
    WHEN payment_status IN ('paid', 'cancelled') THEN payment_status
    WHEN payment_status = 'pending' AND due_date < CURDATE() THEN 'overdue'
    ELSE 'pending'
  END AS effective_status
FROM inspection_charges
WHERE client_email IN (
  'diogodosberto@hotmail.com',
  'Andrezzacarvalhof@gmail.com',
  'Rodrigosantana.14300@gmail.com',
  'Kaioaraujo2233@icloud.com',
  'motomais.acailandia@gmail.com',
  'filippeamurta@gmail.com'
)
ORDER BY due_date DESC
LIMIT 20;
